actual: After BUG-1277 made close-sync GitHub status-label synchronization fail closed, backend/tests/scripts/test_aistock_issue_workflow.py::test_sync_github_issue_after_close_comment_uses_persisted_not_completed still returns empty stdout for every mocked gh issue view. The production code correctly treats the missing CLOSED/label readback as unverified and returns warning, while the stale fixture expects synced. Update only the fixture to provide the required closed status:fixed readback; preserve fail-closed production behavior and the persisted-not-completed comment assertions.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
